issue_context.title: vmware_guest_network unable to change portgroup
issue_context.body:
##### SUMMARY
I'm attempting to use the vmware_guest_network module to change the network associated with a particular interface on a bunch of virtual machines, but it seems as though it never tries to actually change the portgroup for the adapter.

##### ISSUE TYPE
- Bug Report

##### COMPONENT NAME
vmware_guest_network

##### ANSIBLE VERSION
```
ansible 2.9.0
  config file = /home/user/ansible/ansible.cfg
  configured module search path = [u'/home/user/.ansible/plugins/modules', u'/usr/share/ansible/plugins/modules']
  ansible python module location = /usr/lib/python2.7/site-packages/ansible
  executable location = /usr/bin/ansible
  python version = 2.7.13 (default, Jan 03 2017, 17:41:54) [GCC]
```

##### OS / ENVIRONMENT
* OpenSuSE 42.3
* Python 2.7
* Connection to vCenter 6.0 on Windows

##### STEPS TO REPRODUCE
<!--- Describe exactly how to reproduce the problem, using a minimal test-case -->

<!--- Paste example playbooks or commands between quotes below -->
```yaml
    - name: Update network adapter
      vmware_guest_network:
        name: "{{ inventory_hostname }}"
        datacenter: Horizon_7
        cluster: Horizon_Cluster
        hostname: "{{ vchost }}"
        username: "{{ vcuser }}"
        password: "{{ vcpass }}"
        validate_certs: no
        networks:
          - name: "322-VDI"
            state: present
            label: "Network adapter 1"
            connected: false
      delegate_to: localhost
```

##### EXPECTED RESULTS
Network will be changed from its current portgroup to the new one listed in the "name" field above.


##### ACTUAL RESULTS
Network remains in existing configuration.
